title: Scrapling combines adaptive web extraction with crawling and MCP support
friendlyTitle: Scrapling helps software collect data from changing websites
summary: Scrapling is a BSD-licensed Python framework for requests, browser-backed extraction and larger crawls, with adaptive selectors and an MCP server for agent workflows. The repository had about 80,300 stars when reviewed and remains actively maintained.
friendlySummary: Scrapling is a Python web-scraping and crawling tool. It can use normal requests or a browser and can connect to AI agents through MCP.
whyItMatters: It can support monitored research, migration and data-collection workflows where page structures change over time. Users still need to respect site terms, robots rules, privacy obligations and rate limits rather than treating technical access as permission.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can reduce broken data collection when a website changes its layout. Always follow the site’s rules and privacy laws.
